// diagnostic

E2511

Operator `{op}` isn't defined between `{lhs}` and `{rhs}`.

What

Operator `{op}` isn't defined between `{lhs}` and `{rhs}`.

Why

Built-in lane and linalg operators keep fixed shapes: one lane/vector type on both sides, or a matrix and its matching vector; any other pair needs an operator hook.

Fix

Match the operand types (`T.splat(x)` lifts a scalar into every lane), call a named method like `.dot()`/`.matmul()`, or implement the operator's hook trait on your own type for this pair.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2511: tests/ui/math_operator_mismatch.stderr.
